Travel UI design and adapted algorithms

Reference: https://github.com/kaipengfang/travel-shots
Copyright (c) 2026 途影 (TravelShots), MIT License.
The complete license is preserved in TRAVELSHOTS-LICENSE.txt.

Adapted patterns: duplicated photo-river groups, hover/focus/reduced-motion
pause behaviour, shortest-column masonry allocation, full-photo viewer,
and a destination globe with photo markers and a list fallback.
Reference source files read: src/components/PhotoRiver.tsx,
PhotoGallery.tsx, PhotoLightbox.tsx, GlobeMap.tsx.

travel-world.js is converted from public/maps/world.json in that repository
(Natural Earth world geometry). Only geographic outer-ring coordinates are
retained. The orthographic Canvas renderer is a new static implementation;
MapLibre, external map tiles, analytics, likes and EXIF UI are not included.

Destination labels preserve the user's source folder names. Coordinate pairs
are approximate destination centres used only to place schematic markers;
they are not inferred or extracted photo locations.
